name: flux
description: A complete, harness-neutral work cycle for Git repositories: issue, build, peek, review, iterate, land, and reply, plus equip, which prepares the repository.

interface.longDescription: Flux is a shared family of eight workflows that carries work from idea to issue, code, review, iteration, landing, and reply, plus equip, which prepares a repository before the cycle starts. Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex use the same skills, agents, and contracts through native harness adapters.
defaultPrompt: Review this pull request with Flux.
Turn this idea into a well-grounded issue.
Iterate on this PR until its checks settle.
